title: Ultimate Harness Upgrades
description: An add-on for the Better Ghast Harness datapack which visualizes every happy ghast harness tier. Requires ETF to work!
body:
**Ultimate Harness Upgrades** is an add-on resoursepack for the [Better Ghast Harness](https://modrinth.com/mod/fantazs-better-ghast-harness) datapack which visualizes every happy ghast harness tier added by this datapack while it keeps harness color customization from the vanilla harnesses. The tiers are visualized by a chainmail coverage under the harness, a specific glasses tint and the saddle colors taken from the horse armor tiers.

## Harness Tier Appearances
The table below explains the appreance of each tier to easily recognize one in your inventory or on your happy ghast:
| Tier | Chainmail Color |  Glasses Tint  |
| :--: | --------------- | -------------- |
|  1   | (Waxed) Copper  |  Copper/Sepia  |
|  2   |  Gold           |   Sunglasses   |
|  3   |  Iron           | Metallic White |
|  4   |  Diamond        |    Diamonds    |
|  5   |  Netherite      | Metallic Brown |


See the Gallery for screenshots of all the harness tiers.

## Technical Details
The texture is choisen according to the harness tier ID which is written in the `components.minecraft:custom_data.tier` NBT tag of the harness. The base datapack relies on the same tag to apply the speed boost on happy ghasts, so you can freely rename your harness, and the texture will stay the same.

This resourcepack requires Optifine or [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) to enable harness texture selection, since vanilla Minecraft resourcepacks still don't support texture selection for equipment, like it does for items in the player inventory. The item icon selection, though, works using the formerly called feature thanks to the code borrowed from the Faster Happy Ghast official resourcepack.

## Requirements
- [Faster Happy Ghast](https://modrinth.com/datapack/faster-happy-ghast) as the base datapack
- Optifine or [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)
